channel.title: Violations Watch: Yemen
channel.description: New incidents reported in Yemen. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition airstrikes across five Yemeni provinces on 18 Nov: Houthi-run health ministry reports 11 civilians killed and 36 wounded, including three killed at a guesthouse in Mocha; a kidney dialysis centre in al-Hawban, Taiz, reported damaged
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Yemen. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike, Attacks on healthcare & aid. Alleged perpetrator: Saudi-led coalition. Reported casualties: 11 killed, 36 injured. Grave violations against children: Attacks on schools and hospitals. Disputed or caveats: Figures from the Houthi-run health ministry in Sanaa and party-affiliated media (Fars, Saba); the coalition says it hit "60 legitimate military targets". 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1169
